Using operating margin (operating income ÷ operating revenue) as a proxy for cost-efficiency (higher margin = more efficient cost structure for a given revenue level), and calculating:

Delta has the highest operating margin in FY 2024, indicating the most efficient cost structure among the five on this measure.

ANSWER: Delta Air Lines
